prompt_text: waist-high editorial industrial photograph of a cross-functional buyer team calibrating a physical buying scorecard on a project table, with evidence packets, weighted comparison tiles, and a small set of disciplined scoring markers arranged in one bounded framework; the mood should be serious and comparable, rooted in evidence handling rather than charts, stars, or document text. no readable text, no logos, no brand names, no fake dashboards, no staged stock-photo poses, no sci-fi UI, no over-clean symmetry. Target aspect ratio: 16:9 Critical render rule: do not generate any readable text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, slide titles, document copy, dashboard copy, UI text, headline text, wall text, or typographic overlays anywhere in the image. If a screen, board, document, dashboard, scorecard, or interface is visible, it must contain only abstract non-readable blocks, simple shapes, and soft placeholder marks. Never place large title words, marketing slogans, section headers, or composited text for later overlay; leave that area visually quiet and empty instead. Use environmental storytelling and people, not presentation slides or readable screens.
negative_prompt: game show scoring graphics, trophy podium, five-star ratings, readable matrix printout, neon score dashboard.
alt_text_en: show a repeatable automation buying scorecard as a calm calibration ritual tied to evidence, not a flashy scoring game.
caption_en: show a repeatable automation buying scorecard as a calm calibration ritual tied to evidence, not a flashy scoring game.
crop_safe_notes: Composed for 16:9. Use the social role for square-first reuse.
